card.name: Start of phone and fax numbers
card.fires_on: The opening bracket, hyphen or space that begins the area code or number right after 'Telephone', 'Fax', 'call' or 'contact ... at'. It appears in contact details, such as adverse-event reporting lines.

modes.label: Open bracket before area code
modes.description: The '(' that starts an area code after a Fax, Telephone or 'at' cue.

modes.label: Hyphen or space before number
modes.description: The hyphen after the leading 1, or the space before a 1-800 style toll-free number.
modes.example: TopREMS.com or by telephone at 1-800-269-6816 or by FAX at 1<<->>800-558-

card.plain: It marks the spot where a phone or fax number is just starting, in contact lines.
